title.en: Diagnose first: root causes and action plans
title.id: Diagnosis dulu: akar masalah dan rencana tindakan

sources: Written for this lesson from its own objectives: a hypothesis written with a number, reading where people drop off, sorting ideas by impact and ease, and a plan with owners and dates. The methods are standard problem-solving practice, taught here in the lesson's own words. The case, the numbers and the character are invented for this film and appear in no other course or book. No third-party script, footage, picture or sound.

keys.en: Sales are down. *Arga has a cure.*
A cure for the wrong cause is *not a cure*.
keys.id: Obat untuk penyebab yang salah *bukanlah obat*.

say.en: Arga sells iced coffee from a cart near campus. Sales are down, and he already has a cure: a discount.
say.id: Arga berjualan es kopi dengan gerobak di dekat kampus. Penjualannya turun, dan ia sudah punya obatnya: diskon.

say.en: His friend asks one question first. What is the diagnosis? A cure for the wrong cause is not a cure.
say.id: Temannya bertanya dulu. Apa diagnosisnya? Obat untuk penyebab yang salah bukanlah obat.

kicker.en: A hypothesis is a guess that data can kill
kicker.id: Hipotesis adalah tebakan yang bisa dipatahkan data

text.en: People think my coffee is too expensive.
About *6 in 10* buyers never return, because of the price.
text.id: Sekitar *6 dari 10* pembeli tidak kembali karena harganya.

say.en: He starts with a feeling: people think my coffee is too expensive.
say.id: Ia berangkat dari perasaan: orang merasa kopiku kemahalan.

say.en: So he writes a hypothesis with a number in it. About six in ten buyers never return, because of the price.
say.id: Maka ia menulis hipotesis yang memuat angka. Sekitar enam dari sepuluh pembeli tidak kembali karena harganya.

say.en: Before changing anything, he counts for one week. Twelve hundred people walk past the cart.
say.id: Sebelum mengubah apa pun, ia menghitung selama seminggu. Seribu dua ratus orang lewat di depan gerobaknya.

say.en: One hundred and eighty buy, and one hundred and twenty of them come back.
say.id: Seratus delapan puluh membeli, dan seratus dua puluh di antaranya kembali lagi.

say.en: His guess was wrong. Two in three buyers return. The leak is earlier: most people never notice the cart.
say.id: Tebakannya keliru. Dua dari tiga pembeli kembali. Bocornya lebih awal: kebanyakan orang tidak pernah melihat gerobaknya.

h.en: A tall sign, a brighter canopy

say.en: Now he lists ideas, and sorts them by impact and ease. A tall sign and a brighter canopy: high impact, easy. First.
say.id: Kini ia mendaftar ide, lalu memilahnya menurut dampak dan kemudahan. Papan tinggi dan tenda yang lebih terang: dampak besar, mudah. Dikerjakan dulu.

say.en: Moving to the main gate would help more, but it is hard. Asking for help can make a hard idea easier.
say.id: Pindah ke gerbang utama lebih besar dampaknya, tetapi sulit. Meminta bantuan bisa membuat ide yang sulit menjadi lebih mudah.

kicker.en: A plan has owners and dates

say.en: Then every action gets an owner and a date. The sign, by Saturday.
say.id: Lalu setiap tindakan diberi pemilik dan tanggal. Papan, paling lambat Sabtu.

say.en: And in two weeks he counts again. A plan without owners and dates is only a wish.
say.id: Dan dua pekan lagi ia menghitung ulang. Rencana tanpa pemilik dan tanggal hanyalah angan-angan.

points.en: Write your guess *with a number*, so data can kill it.
points.id: Tulis tebakanmu *dengan angka*, supaya data bisa mematahkannya.

turn.en: Pick one problem you are about to fix. Write your hypothesis with a number before you act.
turn.id: Pilih satu masalah yang hendak kamu perbaiki. Tulis hipotesismu dengan angka sebelum bertindak.

say.en: Symptom, diagnosis, prescription. In that order.
say.id: Gejala, diagnosis, resep. Dengan urutan itu.

say.en: Write your guess with a number, so data can kill it.
say.id: Tulis tebakanmu dengan angka, supaya data bisa mematahkannya.

say.en: Now it is your turn. Pick one problem you are about to fix. Write your hypothesis with a number before you act.
say.id: Sekarang giliranmu. Pilih satu masalah yang hendak kamu perbaiki. Tulis hipotesismu dengan angka sebelum bertindak.
